objective: Fix V3.8 false-reject problem (50%) while preserving 103_accuracy=70% and false_elite=0%. Separate 4 questions: EVIDENCE_EXISTS, MOTIVATION_TO_TRY, TECHNICAL_COMPATIBILITY, EXPECTATION_OF_SUCCESS. Add combination penalty, whole-claim test, and 103_precision metric.

v3_8_frozen_results.root_cause: Gemma-4 finds motivation evidence everywhere but over-promotes motivation into obviousness. System rejects granted patents that should survive. Need to separate motivation from technical compatibility and expectation of success.

v3_9_changes: SEPARATE FOUR QUESTIONS: A. EVIDENCE_EXISTS, B. MOTIVATION_TO_TRY, C. TECHNICAL_COMPATIBILITY, D. EXPECTATION_OF_SUCCESS. Do NOT collapse into one LLM verdict.
NEW 103 DECISION CHAIN: REFERENCE_A + REFERENCE_B -> EVIDENCE_EXISTS -> MOTIVATION_TO_TRY -> TECHNICAL_COMPATIBILITY -> EXPECTED_TO_WORK -> COULD/WOULD -> 103. Every edge needs evidence.
MOTIVATION != OBVIOUSNESS: valid motivation edge is NOT sufficient. Require bridge: motivation -> proposed modification -> why this specific modification -> expected benefit.

TECHNICAL COMPATIBILITY SCORING: 8 dimensions (operating_conditions, materials, mechanism, geometry, control_logic, energy_regime, failure_modes, performance_objective). States: COMPATIBLE / COMPATIBLE_WITH_MODIFICATION / INHERENTLY_CONFLICTING / UNKNOWN. INHERENTLY_CONFLICTING blocks combination unless prior art teaches how to resolve.

EXPECTATION OF SUCCESS: separate EXPECTED_SUCCESS from HOPE_OF_SUCCESS. Do NOT accept 'same field' or 'same function' alone. Require evidence that skilled person would reasonably expect combination to work.

COMBINATION PENALTY: if claim requires A from Ref1 + B from Ref2 + C from Ref3, record reference_count and combination_steps. Require evidence for every step. 3-reference reconstruction != single-reference obvious modification.

WHOLE-CLAIM TEST: evaluate claim AS A WHOLE. For each combination: functional_interaction + combined_technical_effect + synergy. Do not say 'A is known + B is known therefore A+B is obvious' without functional interaction.
MODEL ENSEMBLE: Gemma=evidence extraction/reasoning, Nemotron=independent challenge, separate model=structured adjudication. Do not average votes. Force structured evidence.

FALSE-REJECT FORENSICS: for every V3.8 granted case falsely rejected, identify: motivation_false_positive / compatibility_false_positive / expectation_false_positive / whole_claim_failure / technical_effect_failure / adjudication_failure.
PRESERVE false_elite=0%: do NOT sacrifice false_elite to improve accuracy.
NEW METRICS: motivation_precision, motivation_recall, compatibility_precision, expectation_precision, combination_precision, 103_precision, 103_recall
stop_rule: DO NOT run 50->5 until 103>=80% AND 103_precision>=85% AND false_reject<=10%.
